verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs say it connects ERP, CRM and HRIS data into one governed source of truth, and that pipeline, actuals and capacity sit in one live model. It also documents linking an HRIS for hire-level planning and planning headcount in the same connected model as the budget, alongside ERP-driven actuals. Missing for 10: named CRM/HRIS connectors and how they sync, explicit payroll-system coverage, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the HRIS/CRM connectors work as claimed.
